{{Quote|Fuel and weaponry are already assigned; awaiting pickup in deep space caches in Reegian system.|Rebel Alliance Chief of Ordnance and Supply|<ref name="AHC2" />}}
The '''Reegian system''' was located in the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="AHC2" /> at some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]], including "[[Extract of Minutes from the 251st Meeting of the Alliance High Command]]," is set between the end of {{Film|IV}} and the beginning of {{Film|V}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], respectively.</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] planned [[Operation Cobolt]],<ref name="AHC2" /> an assault on a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Imperial orbital base|base]] located in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the<ref name="PlanningMeeting">{{WEGCite|story=Minutes of the Planning Meeting for Operation Cobolt|book=The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC Mantooine">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Mantooine system/Legends|Mantooine system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]].<ref name="RAS2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> As part of the preparations for that operation, the assigned [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] and [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]] were placed in deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] caches in the Reegian [[Star system/Legends|system]], where they then awaited pickup. The Rebel [[Chief of Ordnance and Supply]] noted that fact at the subsequent 251st meeting of the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] held around that [[Time/Legends|time]], with the comment being included in the meeting's minutes that were later extracted.<ref name="AHC2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Reegian system was introduced via mention in "[[Extract of Minutes from the 251st Meeting of the Alliance High Command]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was authored by [[Paul Murphy]] and published in [[1990]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AHC2" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square O-7.<ref name="TEA" />
